{"consolidated_memory":"RECURRING SILENT DROP ISSUE IN notifications/push/dispatch.py (2 SEPARATE OCCASIONS)

=== OCCASION 1: N+1 QUERY SILENT DROP ===
Date: 2026-03-24
Component: notifications/push/dispatch.py (notifications side)
Symptom: Silent drop in dispatcher—send reports success with no delivery
Trigger: Empty input list; specifically dispatch to a device token that was rotated
Root Cause: N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation
Outcome Metric: Nightly rollup matched source counts for 63 days running
Fix: Prefetched the relation in a single query
PR #1223, branch fix/silent-drop-1

=== OCCASION 2: FLOATING POINT ROUNDING SILENT DROP ===
Date: 2026-07-27
Component: notifications/push/dispatch.py (notifications side)
Symptom: Silent drop in dispatcher—send reports success with no delivery
Trigger: Staging read replica; dispatch to a device token that was rotated
Root Cause: Floating point rounding in the money path
Outcome Metric: Flaky test went from 44 failures per 100 runs to zero
Fix: Moved arithmetic to integer minor units
PR #8815, branch fix/silent-drop-3

NOTE: Both incidents affected the same corner of notifications/push/dispatch.py; context from earlier silent drop work carried over to both fixes."}
